This site redistributes the unmodified Pyodide 0.29.3 browser runtime from
the official npm package. Pyodide is distributed under MPL-2.0.
The corresponding source code and notices are available at:
https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.29.3

Pyodide includes CPython and components with their own notices and licences.
CPython licence information:
https://docs.python.org/3.13/license.html
Pyodide build recipes and dependency notices:
https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.29.3

Only the JavaScript loader, WebAssembly interpreter, standard library and
runtime metadata are included. These files are not modified by this project.
The article-analysis code is maintained separately in this repository.
